name: greenmind-studio
description: A local-first coding workspace for creating, organizing, and checking small web projects.

interface.longDescription: Create and organize web project files in a scoped local workspace, inspect files, and run safe JavaScript syntax checks. Requires a compatible local MCP host and Node.js.
defaultPrompt: Open GreenMind Studio Code Lab and help me build and test a web project.
Review my JavaScript for syntax errors and explain the fixes.
Organize my project files and suggest the next development step.
